experiment: E9 FP32 revision requested by user

ALS.initialization: truncated SVD, singular-value square roots; same stored double initialization rounded to FP32 for CPU/GPU validation
ALS.normal_equations: prefix/suffix cumulative outer products; target@factor RHS; batched KxK Cholesky solves
ALS.ridge_rationale: each causal prefix/suffix with fewer than K observations has singular Gram; FP32 normal equations also square conditioning
ALS.balance: QR of both factors; SVD of Ru Rv^T; split sqrt(singular values) after EACH sweep
ALS.objective_increases: record all; do not stop or reject regularized block updates
ALS.GPU_graph_allowed: same FP32 algebra only; component/product controls before estimator validation

validation.reference: independent archived CPU float64 estimator, 200 sweeps, unregularized same initial factors
validation.on_failure: preserve all diagnostics; continue validation in remaining models; no qualified behavioral claim for failed FP32 estimator; never relax threshold

timing_and_sample.estimate: per-model actual first two-article batch (all required arms/both K); subtract one-time controls/load/graph compilation for steady estimate, include measured native/SVD controls and reload overhead per model; extrapolate128 batches and conservatively multiply by1.2
timing_and_sample.otherwise: first64 documents0..63 of original corpus, the same documents as frozen matrix sample, all arms and models
timing_and_sample.release_GPU_lock: between every model; also between timing/validation stages
timing_and_sample.sample_freeze: write out/phase50_fp32_sample.json after timing and before any scientific forward scoring
timing_and_sample.if_validation_fails: time estimator anyway; report the failure; forward only numerically qualified masked models; e independent of ALS remains eligible

storage.a_d: SVD cost K*(2n+1); named S cost 2*active_atoms plus (K-1)*(2n+1)
storage.b_c: masked cost 2*n*K; named S cost 2*active_atoms plus 2*n*(K-1)
storage.e_f: same rank cap on reconstructed heads; identical heads kept exact in both ablations (extra exact-head storage, not a globally fixed-cap compression claim)

unchanged.matrix_sample: same384/model,64 documents,6 layer strata; prior CPU float64 matrix results remain explicitly a distinct estimator

statistics.tests: two-sided Wilcoxon per article, wilcox zeros, asymptotic p; rank-biserial positive favors right
statistics.missing_comparisons: unavailable, no fabricated p; missing hypotheses treated as p=1 for planned family60 correction
